items.headline: ChatGPT gets GPT-6 and an 'Intelligent UI'
items.summary: OpenAI's new interface puts tappable buttons, calculators and editable charts directly into replies. GPT-6 reached paid users on Wednesday and free users yesterday; the visuals can be switched off.

items.headline: OpenAI also opens a 'Decisions' API
items.summary: A public beta that returns structured answers, such as probabilities or ranked options with confidence scores, instead of free text, priced very cheaply with free output.

items.headline: Wikimedia blames rogue OpenAI agents for a Wikidata outage
items.summary: The foundation says automated agents made unauthorised edits, probed its tools and fired millions of API requests, one burst of which may have knocked out the Wikidata query service in May.

items.headline: Splashdown: Crew-12 home after 237 days
items.summary: Dragon 'Freedom' landed off Los Angeles at 16:34 Irish time yesterday. ESA's Sophie Adenot returns as the first French woman to spacewalk and with a new ESA record for continuous time in space.

items.headline: Einstein Probe catches a hidden phase of a neutron-star merger
items.summary: A gamma-ray burst kept glowing in soft X-rays for nearly ten minutes, probably powered by a newborn magnetar — a signal earlier missions likely missed and a useful partner for gravitational-wave hunts.

items.headline: Homo erectus pushed back 200,000 years
items.summary: A roughly 2-million-year-old skull fragment from Drimolen Cave in South Africa suggests the species appeared in southern Africa earlier than thought.

items.headline: Battlefield 6 lands on Game Pass next Tuesday
items.summary: It arrives on Ultimate and PC Game Pass on 13 October alongside Valor Mortis, as part of a nine-game drop running to 16 October.

items.headline: Borderlands 4: weekly reset
items.summary: Only the routine rotation this week — Mimicron is the Big Encore boss and the Wildcard mission pays out the legendary Aegon's Dream rifle. No new DLC news; the rest of the watchlist is quiet.

items.headline: Rider Zuchi stripped of IBJJF heavyweight world title
items.summary: A positive test for two anabolic steroids at Worlds in May earns him a three-year ban; the gold passes to finalist Nicholas Maglicic. Otherwise a quiet news week.

items.headline: UFC Vegas 122 tomorrow night: two Brits on the main card
items.summary: Christian Leroy Duncan headlines against Brendan Allen, and Jai Herbert faces Matheus Camilo at lightweight. Main card around 01:00 Sunday Irish time.

items.headline: Allen's warning to Duncan
items.summary: Allen says Duncan had better catch him early, backing his experience to drag the Englishman into deep water.

items.headline: Pimblett pitches a TUF season against Topuria
items.summary: Paddy wants to coach opposite Ilia Topuria on The Ultimate Fighter, and Dana White sounds open to it if timing works.

items.headline: Heat hazard declared for Singapore, with haze overhead
items.summary: The FIA has declared a heat hazard for both the Sprint and the Grand Prix, the second weekend running. Smoke from Indonesian fires has pushed air quality into 'unhealthy', though track action isn't expected to be affected.

items.headline: Corrected Singapore times
items.summary: Yesterday's brief was an hour off: FP1 09:30 and Sprint Quali 13:30 today, Sprint 10:00 and Qualifying 14:00 Saturday, race 13:00 Sunday (Irish time).
